text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first three years in the Twinkle Series
with
Kitasan Black have come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People have come to recognize not only
her skills
as a runner, but also as a
performer. Thanks to
that...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I'm appearing on a prime
time
singing show! I feel like I'm in a
dream!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This is no dream! It's all thanks to your
amazing
concerts that fans love. And of
course...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's the result of your hard work and
singing
ability. Let's do our best today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, we should warm up first. Let's
begin with
vocal training. Ahem...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Only I'm getting a kiss from the Goddess
of
Victory todaAaAay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oops! I overdid it again! Thanks for the
warning,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: That vibrato! Way too much vibrato!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right. I need to be cute! Cute... I've
gotta be a
pop star Uma!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Umadacchi! Oooh! Umapyoi,
umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black leaps energetically around
the
stage. Her performance is
well-received and
garners rave reviews.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio! We did it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was great! That was probably
your
best performance yet!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I think so too! I worked my butt off
practicing for
it! I wanted everyone to
have the best time of
their lives!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know we performed as a pair today,
but I'm
going to do my best during the
song...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And one day, I hope I'll get asked to do
a solo
enka performance!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita... There's something I have to tell
you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Umapyoi.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Umapyoi. We gotta do "Umapyoi."
Whenever we
go on TV, that's what
we've gotta sing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whaaa? I mean, I like "Umapyoi," but
can't we
sing something else too?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I really like when you sing "Love Is at
the 
Derby☆"! If it was my choice, I'd have
you sing
that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. But we need to sing "Umapyoi"
for our
first song.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The first time I stood on the same stage
as Prez,
she told me something
important...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, Teio. Races are extremely
important
to us Umamusume. However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Winning concerts are equally important
spaces
for us to express ourselves.
Please don't forget
that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A space to express ourselves... What
should I do,
then?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want you to strive for a performance
that only
an Umamusume can give.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You must utilize your running and
jumping ability
in your performance.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you want a song that perfectly
showcases how bright and fun we
Umamusume are, then
"Umapyoi
Legend" is the obvious choice.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that make it the perfect intro to
our
world?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see... How bright and fun Umamusume
are...
When you put it that way, it makes
total sense.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm going to master "Umapyoi
Legend" first
before I get started on my
enka song.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Good. That's the way to do it! Umapyoi
comes
first, and then you follow it up
with some more
Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right! Anything else is just for
breathers—when it's show time, it's
Umapyoi time! Come on,
Trainer, you
join in too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We have to spread Umapyoi
together.
And one day...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We'll be able to be on a big singing
show! Right
then, let's go! One, two...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Teio
text_block_list.text: Umapyoi! Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so another Umamusume passes down her
singing expertise, allowing
their shared concert to
take on a new
form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black continues to polish her
rendition of "Umapyoi." As for the day
she can show off her
enka skills... That's
still far in the future.
